title: Meta Muse alternative: pi-durable-bot (Pots), open source
description: An open-source alternative to Meta Muse: pi-durable-bot (Pots) is an AI coworker for your team that acts on its own, on a machine you choose, with any model.
claim: An AI coworker for your team that acts on its own, on a machine you choose, with any model.
answer: pi-durable-bot (Pots) is an open-source AI coworker that decides when to act and works on its own computer. Muse is Meta's personal AI agent, in its own app and in WhatsApp, on a cloud VM with Meta's Muse Spark model. The difference: Pots runs on any machine you choose, with any model, and keeps its log and memory there.

rivalIs.text: Muse is Meta's personal AI agent that helps with your goals and suggests ideas without being asked. It runs on a dedicated cloud VM with a full browser, and a separate Sentinel agent must approve anything that reaches the internet. You talk to it in the Muse app or in WhatsApp, and it uses Meta's Muse Spark model.

table.note: Muse cells: Meta's public pages, checked 2026-11-10. Your data: with a local model for the agent and the judge, nothing leaves your machine; with a hosted model, requests go to the provider you chose.

pickRival: You want a personal agent in WhatsApp, with nothing to install.
You want a free plan that someone else hosts.
You want a Sentinel agent to approve all internet access.
You want to use its cloud browser yourself, too.
pickPots: You want a coworker in your team's channels, not a personal app.
You want the code, and to change the agent itself.
You want any model, including a local one.

faq.a: No. Meta's pages offer no source code or self-hosted version; Muse runs on a cloud VM the maker hosts.
Meta's posts name the US, Canada and Singapore, and Muse is in limited testing. Pots installs from npm on any machine you choose.

No. The other products as their makers described them in public, checked 2026-11-10; they may have changed since. Grok Bot, dots, Claude Duet, Claude Tag and Muse are products of SpaceXSI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. pi-durable-bot is not affiliated with any of them.
